Settings.ApiKeyDescription: Required for AssemblyAI transcription and streaming.
Settings.UseDictionaryTermsDescription: Biases transcription toward your dictionary terms, each sent whole (commas included). AssemblyAI charges extra for keyterms with Universal-3 Pro and in non-English real-time dictation; Universal-2 includes them. Real-time dictation sends at most 100 terms of up to 50 characters. When off, AssemblyAI receives no dictionary terms.
Settings.NotConfiguredApiKeyRequired: Plugin not configured. API key required.
Manifest.Name: AssemblyAI
